answer: Four audits that were red or hanging, and one that fails only in a sweep, are all green and inside the sweep. The sweep is 25 and packaged 123 is 25/25.
how_this_started: Build 120 proved that an audit outside Scripts/run_quick_audits.sh can stay red for dozens of builds, because every green sweep said nothing about it. So the next move was to find the remaining reds, not to ship.

found_and_fixed.was: failed in 8 s: "Practice timer ran before gateway", distance_cm 0.0
found_and_fixed.cause: The sweep's COMMON flags pass -BattleSkipTutorial. The audit covers tutorial-time behaviour, so it was being run with the feature it tests switched off.
found_and_fixed.fix: run_quick_audits.sh now takes a NoSkipTutorial token per entry that drops -BattleSkipTutorial for that audit only.
found_and_fixed.now: {"passed":true,"reason":"Untimed practice, actual road ride, controllable gate countdown and single-start timer pass","distance_cm":7572.0,"max_error_cm":37.2}

found_and_fixed.was: hung forever with no verdict at all
found_and_fixed.cause: ABattleMarketClosure::Tick destroys the fence the moment bTutorialActive is false. With -BattleSkipTutorial the fence deleted itself before the audit could tick, so the audit never ran and never reported.
found_and_fixed.fix: same NoSkipTutorial token. The fence behaviour is the game's designed behaviour and was left alone.
found_and_fixed.now: {"passed":true,"jump":false,"on_foot":false,"reason":"Real W approach remained outside gate; foot mode sprints; jump requires airtime","closest_cm":55.08}

found_and_fixed.was: failed packed and editor: phase 1, "No nearby spare interaction", bikes 6
found_and_fixed.cause: Stale fixture, not a game bug. Dismount plays a 0.45 s step-off that rewrites the rider's position every tick, and the audit teleported to the spare bike immediately after Dismount(), so the next step-off frame dragged the rider back out of Nearest()'s 240 cm range. BattlePickupAudit had already been taught this lesson in build 112; this audit had not.
found_and_fixed.fix: two new wait phases that hold until StepOffRemaining is 0 before approaching, with a 4 s deadline that reports "Dismount never settled". Registers the user-visible spare-bike swap, which is what a player walking up to a spare bike and pressing E relies on.
found_and_fixed.now: {"passed":true,"phase":4,"reason":"Actual spare stations, E interaction, carried ammo/health/horns, swimming guard and riding the abandoned bike again pass"}

found_and_fixed.was: failed standalone and in sweeps: stage 3, "Live witness did not flee away and remain panicked", male_travel 305 cm, female_travel 0 cm
found_and_fixed.this_one_looked_impossible: The identical packaged 120 binary PASSED at 12:03 with male_travel 1063 cm and female_travel 1285 cm, then failed five runs in a row at 12:21 on the same bytes, in the editor as well. The 120 bundle has no symlinks and no file inside it newer than 12:03, so nothing on disk had moved.
found_and_fixed.cause: The audit started at a fixed 5 s of GAME time, while the runtime navigation mesh for this world builds on WALL-CLOCK time. On a loaded machine the witnesses were spawned - and then asked to flee - before the mesh existed, so they stood still. This is the same shape as the BattleTroubleAudit fix in build 112.
found_and_fixed.fix: wait for FNavigationSystem IsNavigationBuildInProgress() to clear instead of guessing, with a 150 s deadline that reports "Navigation never finished building" so a real hang still terminates. The stage 3 verdict now names which of the four conditions failed and prints travel, away-distance, panic and speed rather than one message covering all four.
found_and_fixed.now: two clean passes: male 1147.22 / female 1042.17 and male 1146.54 / female 1294.08, against 1063 / 1285 for the one earlier pass - the same profile.

found_and_fixed.was: stage 7, "Actual pistol shot did not hit distant drone or show feedback" - failing in three consecutive packaged sweeps (120 editor, 121, 122) while passing every standalone run
found_and_fixed.cause: Three failures in a row with a standalone pass in between is not random load, so it got fixed rather than waved through. The aim is re-applied every tick, but the player view follows a frame later, so a fixed 0.2 s of stage clock could fire at where the crosshair had been rather than where the drone is.
found_and_fixed.fix: the shot is gated on the view actually being within 1.5 degrees of the drone, for both the wounding shot and the killing shot. The 18 s timeout still guards a genuine miss.
found_and_fixed.now: passes inside the packaged sweep for the first time since build 120

traps_found: A unity-build landmine: editing BattleDroneAudit.cpp changed its size, which shifted UE's unity blob composition and pulled BattleScooterRideAudit.cpp (file-static "Closest") into the same blob as BattleTutorialAudit.cpp's local "Closest". Under -Werror -Wshadow that failed the build with an error in a file nobody had touched. Renamed the file-static to ScooterClosestCm. Read this as: a build failure after a small edit may point at a different file entirely.

The sweep had no timeout. BattleTutorialAudit returned "passed":true, logged PreExit Game, and then sat at 2% CPU for eighteen minutes while the sweep waited on nothing. run_quick_audits.sh now kills an audit after BATTLE_AUDIT_TIMEOUT (default 420 s) and still reads the verdict afterwards, so an audit that finished and lingered is scored on its own result.

sweep.note: Build 120 was 21. The four new ones are the ones that were red or hanging and unwatched.
